ModMetaData.name: Swarmling Art Override
ModMetaData.author: Mandrake
ModMetaData.description: Replaces Vanilla Factions Expanded - Insectoids 2's VFEI2_Swarmling art (south/east/north facings only) with a render generated for this campaign (Greentide sheet 2026-10-05, owner pick C). LABEL/ART ONLY - no defName touched, no Defs, no Patches, loose Textures/ only, same relative path (Things/Pawn/Animal/Swarmling/Swarmling_<facing>) the donor uses so this mod's later load order wins the same-path resolution.
